prompt: Reach the blue target crate at (11,1) and follow the first matching rule at every step. If the robot is at (11,1), choose STOP. If the column is 6 or less and the row is greater than 1, choose UP. If the row is 1 and the column is less than 7, choose RIGHT. If the column is 7 and the row is less than 7, choose DOWN. If the row is 7 and the column is less than 11, choose RIGHT. If the column is between 9 and 10, choose RIGHT. If the column is 11 and the row is greater than 1, choose UP.
